answer: Resist sybils by binding influence to a slow-growing cedar record: an append-only log of completed jobs that gains weight only when at least three uncorrelated counterparties countersign across successive epochs. New addresses begin under a velvet throttle—trade is allowed, but attestation power and the right to vouch for others vest at one-twelfth per epoch for twelve epochs, so a same-day clone farm stays nearly weightless. No single identity or detected cluster may exceed a 2 percent zenith of an epoch's attestation weight; any surplus is burned rather than reassigned to the same cluster.
